title: Harmony Has Cheese

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Tell me about it. Like, every morning I ask myself, Harmony, is the backache from wearing a portable mini-mart for eighteen hours a day really worth it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me about it. Like, every morning I ask myself, Harmony, is the backache from wearing a portable mini-mart for eighteen hours a day really worth it?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Heck yeah it is. You should see my takings! If this carries on I'm gonna add another wing onto this baby. Anyway, what can I do for you today?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heck yeah it is. You should see my takings! If this carries on I'm gonna add another wing onto this baby. Anyway, what can I do for you today?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I've never heard of that or any other secret, illegal cheese.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've never heard of that or any other secret, illegal cheese.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: TMB's crazy. Shouldn't listen to a word he says.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: TMB's crazy. Shouldn't listen to a word he says.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Sorry pal, but I've seen the Corpo types you hang with. I'm not saying you're a snitch but... people like me gotta be careful of people like you. No offense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry pal, but I've seen the Corpo types you hang with. I'm not saying you're a snitch but... people like me gotta be careful of people like you. No offense.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Say I did have an air-lock compartment in this baby, and say that compartment did contain a small quantity of contraband dairy... what do you want it for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say I did have an air-lock compartment in this baby, and say that compartment did contain a small quantity of contraband dairy... what do you want it for?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Anything else, you know where to find me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything else, you know where to find me.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I'm not selling you shit Corpster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not selling you shit Corpster.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: The rat guy? I mean, OK, I see that. Rodents go wild for this stuff. Like, fully possessed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rat guy? I mean, OK, I see that. Rodents go wild for this stuff. Like, fully possessed.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I hope you know what you're doing. Friend of mine ate some at a Trip Roulette party. They still can't get the stains out of the ceiling.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope you know what you're doing. Friend of mine ate some at a Trip Roulette party. They still can't get the stains out of the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Normally I'd charge 200 Lims, but you found old Floyd for me after all these years so, let's call it 100.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Normally I'd charge 200 Lims, but you found old Floyd for me after all these years so, let's call it 100.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Cheese that could get me four years in a chain gang in the wastes if anyone found out I sold it to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cheese that could get me four years in a chain gang in the wastes if anyone found out I sold it to you.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Cheese that could get me four years in a chain gang in the wastes if anyone found out I sold it to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cheese that could get me four years in a chain gang in the wastes if anyone found out I sold it to you.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Pleasure doing business. Now get out of here before someone smells it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pleasure doing business. Now get out of here before someone smells it.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Another chance? Hmmm. What do you want it for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Another chance? Hmmm. What do you want it for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm looking for some Green Reeker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm looking for some Green Reeker.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm looking for some Green Reeker.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm looking for some Green Reeker.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But people say you stock everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But people say you stock everything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But people say you stock everything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But people say you stock everything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sell me the cheese or I'll report you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sell me the cheese or I'll report you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sell me the cheese or I'll report you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sell me the cheese or I'll report you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you have heard of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you have heard of it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you have heard of it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you have heard of it.
